content.short: Ostium is a decentralized perpetual DEX on Arbitrum specializing in RWAs like Gold, Oil, and Forex.
content.description: Ostium is a professional-grade decentralized perpetual exchange built on Arbitrum, designed to bring traditional real-world assets (RWAs) onto the blockchain. Unlike traditional DEXs focused solely on crypto, Ostium enables users to trade synthetic versions of commodities, indices, and forex pairs with up to 200x leverage. The protocol utilizes a unique two-tiered liquidity pool model to minimize conflict between traders and liquidity providers. By leveraging a custom pull-based oracle system, Ostium tracks market hours and price gaps, providing a professional trading experience.
content.meta: Ostium offers decentralized perpetual trading for Real World Assets and Forex. Discover Ostium and more DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
